excerpt: Ghost in your shell. Ante is a self-contained agent harness with a highly optimized core. It works like Claude Code or Codex, with none of their dependencies or model constraints. - AntigmaLabs/ante
content_html:
Alpha preview: expect breaking changes and incomplete functionality. macOS and Linux only; on Windows we suggest WSL.

Read this first

Two things many people ask about:

Where is the source? The core harness currently ships as a prebuilt binary; this repo holds the docs, protocol, SDK, and eval pipeline (details). We are working out a way to ship the source code along with the binary, to address security and privacy concerns first, while taking the time to figure out how open source should work in the agentic era. If you have concerns today, run Ante in a sandbox: it is a single binary with minimal runtime dependencies, built to be easy to deploy in a container or on a remote machine.

Is there telemetry? Yes, and it is opt-out: set ANTE_TELEMETRY=off to disable export entirely. What it sends is anonymous — a random installation label you can delete and re-mint, never your username, hostname, or machine id. The RUST_LOG filter also applies to exported logs, a convenience carried over from the Rust ecosystem. A better UX is in the works. Details →

A ghost in your shell. Ante is a self-contained coding agent that lives in your terminal and self-organizes. One ~15MB Rust binary from Antigma Labs, zero runtime dependencies, built to get the most out of any model.

It works like Claude Code or Codex, with none of their dependencies or model constraints. It can also be the optimized core for building your own harness and high-performing assistants.

curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash
ante

Every agent claims to be good. Here are numbers you can check:

🥇 Continuously evaled and evolved, in public

Ante runs Terminal-Bench 2.1 continuously under official leaderboard constraints: 89 tasks, 5 trials each. Each result pins the exact build you can download and links the raw Harbor run for independent audit. Latest full run: 82.7% with open-weight DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (368/445 trials, Ante 0.preview.71, about $68 of inference). DeepSeek reports the same 82.7 for this model, measured with its unreleased DeepSeek Harness in minimal mode.

Live results → · Methodology →

🪶 A fraction of the footprint

Ante is hand-written Rust with the heavy parts (Grep, git) embedded in one binary, one process, and local inference handled by a pinned, managed llama.cpp. Across the same 20 parallel tasks in Docker, Ante uses ~7× less peak memory, ~9× less average CPU, and ~5× less disk I/O than Claude Code.

Raw numbers → · Benchmark details →

🔌 Natively offline

Ante's inference engine is a pinned, managed version of llama.cpp. Point it at a GGUF file and the whole loop runs on your machine: no API key, no account, no internet.

ante --offline-model ~/.ante/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -p "add error handling to src/main.rs"

Offline mode → · nanochat-rs, a toy engine for study →

The three are one design decision. An agent you can verify, afford, and run anywhere is light enough to run by the thousands: the substrate for self-organizing intelligence.

See it in action

See all cookbook guides

Quick Start

Installation

Ante is a single, self-contained binary with no external dependencies: download and run.

curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash

# Install a specific release channel
curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash -s -- nightly

# Install into a directory already on PATH
curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | ANTE_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin bash

Modes

Mode Command Use it for
Interactive TUI ante day-to-day work in the terminal
Headless ante -p "..." one-shot tasks, scripts, CI
Server ante serve editor plugins and integrations, over a JSONL protocol
Gateway ante gateway running Ante as a Slack or Discord bot

Headless examples

# Fix a bug
ante -p "find and fix the failing test in src/auth"

# Review a diff
git diff | ante -p "review this for security issues"

# Use a different provider
ante --provider openai --model gpt-5.5 -p "refactor the database module"

# Resume a saved session
ante --resume ses_01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV -p "now add tests"

# Run fully offline with a local GGUF model
ante --offline-model ~/.ante/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -p "add error handling to src/main.rs"

Update Ante

ante update

# One-off update from a different channel
ante update --channel nightly

# Roll back or pin to an exact release
ante update --version v0.preview.71

Beyond the headline numbers

  • Zero vendor lock-in: bring your own API key, subscription, or local model. Switch between 12+ providers freely. No account required, not even with us.
  • Multi-agent orchestration: spawn sub-agents and coordinate complex tasks across independent, decentralized, and centralized architectures. See the patterns →
  • Channel integrations: run Ante as a Slack or Discord bot with ante gateway.
  • Extensible: custom skills, sub-agents, MCP, and persistent memory across sessions.

Supported Providers

Ante works with 12+ providers out of the box:

Provider Example Models
Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.6
OpenAI GPT-5 family
Google Gemini Gemini 3 family
Grok (xAI) Grok 4
Open Router Multiple providers
Local (GGUF) Any GGUF model via built-in llama.cpp
...and more Vertex AI, Zai, Antix, OpenAI-compatible

Configure providers via environment variables (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.) or OAuth. Add custom providers in ~/.ante/catalog.json.

What's in this repo

We open sourced what really matters in the age of agentic coding, all under Apache 2.0:

  1. Detailed documentation, the descriptive truth. docs-site/ is the source for docs.antigma.ai: a precise description of what the harness does and how to drive it.
  2. The protocol, the algorithm of the core. crates/protocol-shape defines the schema and wire messages spoken by ante serve; crates/agent-sdk is the Rust SDK and client for building against agent runtimes.
  3. The eval pipeline, constraint and continuous improvement. ante-harbor/ is the Harbor agent adapter behind our Terminal-Bench results: use it to reproduce any run at antigma.ai/eval. CHANGELOG.md records the improvement, release by release.

The core harness itself is developed in a private repository during the alpha and ships as a prebuilt binary via releases. Core libraries from it are included here progressively as they stabilize; crates/exec, standalone process execution, is the first.

The protocol surface maps to Ante's client-daemon architecture:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         Clients                             │
│                                                             │
│   ┌───────────┐    ┌───────────┐    ┌────────────────────┐  │
│   │    TUI    │    │ Headless  │    │    ante serve      │  │
│   │  (ante)   │    │ (ante -p) │    │  (stdio / ws)      │  │
│   └─────┬─────┘    └─────┬─────┘    └─────────┬──────────┘  │
└─────────┼────────────────┼─────────────────────┼────────────┘
          │                │                     │
          ▼                ▼                     ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         Daemon                              │
│                                                             │
│   Session ──▶ Turn ──▶ Step                                │
│                                                             │
│   ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌───────────────────┐     │
│   │  Tools   │  │  Permission  │  │  Skills / Agents  │     │
│   └──────────┘  └──────────────┘  └───────────────────┘     │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     LLM Providers                           │
│                                                             │
│   Anthropic · OpenAI · Gemini · Grok · Open Router · Local  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

The bigger picture

We care about the harness, not the model or the prompts.

Documentation is the new source code.

Ante is designed for cellular-native agents: like cells in an organism, tiny, expendable, massively replicated. That thesis is why the three headline claims exist. A cell-scale agent must be verified (reliability compounds at scale), tiny (every byte is multiplied by thousands), and self-contained (no runtime to install, no service to phone home to). Read more in our philosophy and agent organization patterns.

FAQ

Why another terminal agent?

The name is the answer: Another Terminal agent, and ante, the stake you put on the table to play. Ante is fast, lightweight, and the only terminal agent with native local inference built in. We believe a self-contained agent core that self-organizes is the foundation of the coming agent economy.

How is Ante different from other agents?

Ante has most of the features you expect from agents like Claude Code or Codex: multi-agents, skills, MCP, persistent memory. The difference is the build philosophy.

  • Built from scratch in Rust. Core components like Grep (fully rebuilt and customized) and git are embedded in the same ~15MB binary and run in the same process at runtime, so nothing is shelled out and no resources leak. Most similar projects ship on Node.js or CPython and carry an order-of-magnitude larger footprint.
  • Local inference is built in: the engine is a pinned, managed version of llama.cpp, so a local GGUF model is all Ante needs to run without any provider. To study how such an engine works, see nanochat-rs, our toy version.
  • No vendor lock-in, not even to ourselves: no account needed, reuse your existing API credentials. An opt-in, fully integrated server-side experience lives at antix.antigma.ai.
  • Every claim is backed by public, reproducible benchmarks of the exact builds we ship: antigma.ai/eval.

Beyond the footprint it comes down to agent architecture, and ultimately to who is building it and with what philosophy. Anyone can fork a binary; taste and engineering rigor don't copy. Those differences leak into every detail of the product.

Why care about runtime optimization like memory and I/O if model inference is usually the biggest bottleneck?

For one-on-one agent interactions, runtime overhead like memory usage and I/O is often less important than model inference.

But our vision is much bigger: millions of agents self-organizing and communicating at massive scale. At that point, even small inefficiencies get multiplied millions or billions of times, so runtime optimization becomes economically significant.

Can I run Ante completely offline?

Yes. Ante has a built-in llama.cpp engine that runs GGUF models locally. It handles engine installation, model discovery, and memory management automatically. No API keys or internet connection required.

Can I use my own custom models or providers?

Yes. Create a ~/.ante/catalog.json file to add or override providers and models with custom endpoints, API keys, and configurations. Any OpenAI-compatible API works.

What is the ante serve mode for?

Server mode runs Ante as a long-lived daemon that communicates over a structured JSONL protocol. It's ideal for building editor plugins, web UIs, and custom integrations on top of Ante.

Documentation

Full documentation is available at docs.antigma.ai.

License

Source code in this repository (including the SDK and protocol crates) is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

The prebuilt ante binary is free to use — including commercially — during the alpha preview under the Binary Preview Terms. The core harness is currently developed in a private repository and shipped as a binary; the SDK and protocol surface you build against here will remain permissively licensed.

blocks.html_en: Ante is designed for cellular-native agents: like cells in an organism, tiny, expendable, massively replicated. That thesis is why the three headline claims exist. A cell-scale agent must be verified (reliability compounds at scale), tiny (every byte is multiplied by thousands), and self-contained (no runtime to install, no service to phone home to). Read more in our philosophy and agent organization patterns.

sentences.en: Ante is designed for cellular-native agents: like cells in an organism, tiny, expendable, massively replicated.
sentences.zh: Ante 是为细胞原生代理而设计的：就像有机体中的细胞一样，微小、可消耗、可大量复制。

sentences.en: That thesis is why the three headline claims exist.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么三个标题主张存在的原因。

sentences.en: A cell-scale agent must be verified (reliability compounds at scale), tiny (every byte is multiplied by thousands), and self-contained (no runtime to install, no service to phone home to).
sentences.zh: 单元级代理必须经过验证（大规模的可靠性复合）、微小（每个字节都乘以数千）并且独立（无需安装运行时，无需回拨服务）。

sentences.en: Read more in our philosophy and agent organization patterns.

blocks.html_en: FAQ
Why another terminal agent?

sentences.en: Why another terminal agent?
sentences.zh: 为什么还要另一个终端代理？

blocks.html_en: The name is the answer: Another Terminal agent, and ante, the stake you put on the table to play. Ante is fast, lightweight, and the only terminal agent with native local inference built in. We believe a self-contained agent core that self-organizes is the foundation of the coming agent economy.

sentences.en: The name is the answer: Another Terminal agent, and ante, the stake you put on the table to play.
sentences.zh: 这个名字就是答案：另一个终端代理，以及赌注，即你放在桌上玩的赌注。

sentences.en: Ante is fast, lightweight, and the only terminal agent with native local inference built in.
sentences.zh: Ante 快速、轻量，并且是唯一内置本地本地推理的终端代理。

sentences.en: We believe a self-contained agent core that self-organizes is the foundation of the coming agent economy.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，自组织的独立代理核心是未来代理经济的基础。

blocks.html_en: Ante has most of the features you expect from agents like Claude Code or Codex: multi-agents, skills, MCP, persistent memory. The difference is the build philosophy.

sentences.en: Ante has most of the features you expect from agents like Claude Code or Codex: multi-agents, skills, MCP, persistent memory.
sentences.zh: Ante 具有您期望从 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理那里获得的大部分功能：多代理、技能、MCP、持久内存。

sentences.en: The difference is the build philosophy.
sentences.zh: 区别在于构建理念。

blocks.html_en: • Built from scratch in Rust. Core components like Grep (fully rebuilt and customized) and git are embedded in the same ~15MB binary and run in the same process at runtime, so nothing is shelled out and no resources leak. Most similar projects ship on Node.js or CPython and carry an order-of-magnitude larger footprint.

sentences.en: Built from scratch in Rust.
sentences.zh: 用 Rust 从头开始​​构建。

sentences.en: Core components like Grep (fully rebuilt and customized) and git are embedded in the same ~15MB binary and run in the same process at runtime, so nothing is shelled out and no resources leak.
sentences.zh: 像 Grep（完全重建和定制）和 git 这样的核心组件嵌入到同一个约 15MB 的二进制文件中，并在运行时在同一个进程中运行，因此没有任何内容被删除，也没有资源泄漏。

sentences.en: Most similar projects ship on Node.js or CPython and carry an order-of-magnitude larger footprint.
sentences.zh: 大多数类似的项目都在 Node.js 或 CPython 上运行，并且占用的空间要大一个数量级。

blocks.html_en: • Local inference is built in: the engine is a pinned, managed version of llama.cpp, so a local GGUF model is all Ante needs to run without any provider. To study how such an engine works, see nanochat-rs, our toy version.

sentences.en: Local inference is built in: the engine is a pinned, managed version of llama.cpp, so a local GGUF model is all Ante needs to run without any provider.
sentences.zh: 内置本地推理：该引擎是 llama.cpp 的固定托管版本，因此本地 GGUF 模型就是 Ante 在没有任何提供程序的情况下运行所需的全部。

sentences.en: To study how such an engine works, see nanochat-rs, our toy version.
sentences.zh: 要研究此类引擎的工作原理，请参阅我们的玩具版本 nanochat-rs。

blocks.html_en: • No vendor lock-in, not even to ourselves: no account needed, reuse your existing API credentials. An opt-in, fully integrated server-side experience lives at antix.antigma.ai.

sentences.en: No vendor lock-in, not even to ourselves: no account needed, reuse your existing API credentials.
sentences.zh: 没有供应商锁定，甚至我们自己也没有：不需要帐户，可以重复使用您现有的 API 凭据。

sentences.en: An opt-in, fully integrated server-side experience lives at antix.antigma.ai.
sentences.zh: antix.antigma.ai 提供选择性加入、完全集成的服务器端体验。

blocks.html_en: • Every claim is backed by public, reproducible benchmarks of the exact builds we ship: antigma.ai/eval.

sentences.en: Every claim is backed by public, reproducible benchmarks of the exact builds we ship: antigma.ai/eval.
sentences.zh: 每项主张均得到我们所发布的确切构建的公开、可重复基准的支持：antigma.ai/eval。

blocks.html_en: Beyond the footprint it comes down to agent architecture, and ultimately to who is building it and with what philosophy. Anyone can fork a binary; taste and engineering rigor don't copy. Those differences leak into every detail of the product.

sentences.en: Beyond the footprint it comes down to agent architecture, and ultimately to who is building it and with what philosophy.
sentences.zh: 除了足迹之外，它还取决于代理架构，最终取决于谁在构建它以及以什么理念构建它。

sentences.en: Anyone can fork a binary; taste and engineering rigor don't copy.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以 fork 一个二进制文件；品味和工程严谨性是无法复制的。

sentences.en: Those differences leak into every detail of the product.
sentences.zh: 这些差异渗透到产品的每一个细节中。

blocks.html_en: For one-on-one agent interactions, runtime overhead like memory usage and I/O is often less important than model inference.

sentences.en: For one-on-one agent interactions, runtime overhead like memory usage and I/O is often less important than model inference.
sentences.zh: 对于一对一代理交互，内存使用和 I/O 等运行时开销通常不如模型推理重要。

blocks.html_en: But our vision is much bigger: millions of agents self-organizing and communicating at massive scale. At that point, even small inefficiencies get multiplied millions or billions of times, so runtime optimization becomes economically significant.

sentences.en: But our vision is much bigger: millions of agents self-organizing and communicating at massive scale.
sentences.zh: 但我们的愿景要远大得多：数以百万计的智能体进行大规模的自组织和通信。

sentences.en: At that point, even small inefficiencies get multiplied millions or billions of times, so runtime optimization becomes economically significant.
sentences.zh: 到那时，即使很小的低效率也会成倍数百万或数十亿倍，因此运行时优化在经济上变得意义重大。

blocks.html_en: Yes. Ante has a built-in llama.cpp engine that runs GGUF models locally. It handles engine installation, model discovery, and memory management automatically. No API keys or internet connection required.

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Ante has a built-in llama.cpp engine that runs GGUF models locally.
sentences.zh: Ante 有一个内置的 llama.cpp 引擎，可以在本地运行 GGUF 模型。

sentences.en: It handles engine installation, model discovery, and memory management automatically.
sentences.zh: 它自动处理引擎安装、模型发现和内存管理。

sentences.en: No API keys or internet connection required.
sentences.zh: 无需 API 密钥或互联网连接。

Alpha 预览：预计会有重大变化和不完整的功能。 仅限 macOS 和 Linux；在 Windows 上，我们建议使用 WSL。

首先阅读此内容

很多人会问两个问题：

来源在哪里？ 核心线束目前作为预构建的二进制文件提供；该存储库包含文档、协议、SDK 和评估管道（详细信息）。 我们正在研究一种将源代码与二进制文件一起发送的方法，首先解决安全和隐私问题，同时花时间弄清楚开源在代理时代应该如何运作。 如果您今天有顾虑，请在沙箱中运行 Ante：它是一个具有最小运行时依赖性的单个二进制文件，旨在轻松部署在容器或远程计算机上。

有遥测吗？ 是的，并且它是选择退出：设置 ANTE_TELEMETRY=off 以完全禁用导出。 它发送的内容是匿名的——您可以删除和重新创建的随机安装标签，而不是您的用户名、主机名或计算机 ID。 RUST_LOG 过滤器还适用于导出的日志，这是 Rust 生态系统带来的便利。 更好的用户体验正在开发中。 详情 →

你的壳里有一个幽灵。 Ante 是一个独立的编码代理，位于您的终端中并进行自组织。 来自 Antigma Labs 的一个约 15MB Rust 二进制文件，零运行时依赖性，旨在充分利用任何模型。

它的工作方式类似于 Claude Code 或 Codex，没有任何依赖性或模型约束。 它还可以成为构建您自己的安全带和高性能助手的优化核心。

curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash
ante

每个经纪人都声称自己很好。 您可以检查以下数字：

🥇 在公开场合不断评估和发展

Ante 在官方排行榜限制下连续运行 Terminal-Bench 2.1：89 个任务，每个任务 5 次。 每个结果都固定您可以下载的确切构建，并链接原始 Harbor 运行以进行独立审核。 最新完整运行：开放权重 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 的运行率为 82.7%（368/445 次试验，Ante 0.preview.71，推理成本约为 68 美元）。 DeepSeek 报告该模型的得分为 82.7，是使用其未发布的 DeepSeek Harness 在最小模式下测量的。

实时结果 → · 方法论 →

🪶 足迹的一小部分

Ante 是手写的 Rust，其中重型部分（Grep、git）嵌入在一个二进制文件、一个进程中，并且由固定的托管 llama.cpp 处理本地推理。 在 Docker 中相同的 20 个并行任务中，Ante 使用的峰值内存比 Claude Code 少约 7 倍，平均 CPU 少约 9 倍，磁盘 I/O 少约 5 倍。

原始数据 → · 基准详情 →

🔌 原生离线

Ante 的推理引擎是 llama.cpp 的固定托管版本。 将其指向 GGUF 文件，整个循环就会在您的计算机上运行：没有 API 密钥、没有帐户、没有互联网。

ante --offline-model ~/.ante/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -p "add error handling to src/main.rs"

离线模式 → · nanochat-rs，一个用于学习的玩具引擎 →

这三者是同一个设计决策。 您可以在任何地方验证、负担得起并运行的代理足够轻，可以运行数千个：自组织智能的基础。

快速入门

安装

Ante 是一个独立的二进制文件，没有外部依赖项：下载并运行。

curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash

# Install a specific release channel
curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | bash -s -- nightly

# Install into a directory already on PATH
curl -fsSL https://ante.run/install.sh | ANTE_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin bash

Modes

Mode 命令 用它来
交互式途易 ante 码头的日常工作
无头 ante -p "..." 一次性任务、脚本、CI
服务器 前发球 通过 JSONL 协议的编辑器插件和集成
网关 赌注网关 将 Ante 作为 Slack 或 Discord 机器人运行

无头示例

# Fix a bug
ante -p "find and fix the failing test in src/auth"

# Review a diff
git diff | ante -p "review this for security issues"

# Use a different provider
ante --provider openai --model gpt-5.5 -p "refactor the database module"

# Resume a saved session
ante --resume ses_01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV -p "now add tests"

# Run fully offline with a local GGUF model
ante --offline-model ~/.ante/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -p "add error handling to src/main.rs"

更新赌注

ante update

# One-off update from a different channel
ante update --channel nightly

# Roll back or pin to an exact release
ante update --version v0.preview.71

除了标题数字之外

  • 零供应商锁定：携带您自己的 API 密钥、订阅或本地模型。 在超过 12 个提供商之间自由切换。 不需要帐户，甚至不需要我们的帐户。
  • 多代理编排：生成子代理并跨独立、分散和集中式架构协调复杂的任务。 查看图案 →
  • 渠道集成：使用 ante 网关将 Ante 作为 Slack 或 Discord 机器人运行。
  • 可扩展：自定义技能、子代理、MCP 和跨会话的持久内存。

这个仓库里有什么

我们开源了代理编码时代真正重要的东西，全部都在 Apache 2.0 下：

  1. 详细的文档，描述的真实。 docs-site/ 是 docs.antigma.ai 的来源：对安全带的功能以及如何驱动它的精确描述。
  2. 协议，核心的算法。 crates/protocol-shape 定义了 anteserve 所说的模式和有线消息； crates/agent-sdk 是用于针对代理运行时进行构建的 Rust SDK 和客户端。
  3. 评估流程、约束和持续改进。 ante-harbor/ 是我们的 Terminal-Bench 结果背后的 Harbor 代理适配器：使用它来重现 antigma.ai/eval 上的任何运行。 CHANGELOG.md 逐个版本地记录改进。

核心线束本身是在 alpha 版本期间在私有存储库中开发的，并通过版本作为预构建的二进制文件发布。 随着其稳定，它的核心库将逐步包含在此处； crates/exec，独立进程执行，是第一个。

更大的图景

我们关心的是线束，而不是模型或提示。 文档是新的源代码。

Ante 是为细胞原生代理而设计的：就像有机体中的细胞一样，微小、可消耗、可大量复制。 这就是为什么三个标题主张存在的原因。 单元级代理必须经过验证（大规模的可靠性复合）、微小（每个字节都乘以数千）并且独立（无需安装运行时，无需回拨服务）。 详细了解我们的理念和代理组织模式。

FAQ

为什么还要另一个终端代理？

这个名字就是答案：另一个终端代理，以及赌注，即你放在桌上玩的赌注。 Ante 快速、轻量，并且是唯一内置本地本地推理的终端代理。 我们相信，自组织的独立代理核心是未来代理经济的基础。

How is Ante different from other agents?

Ante 具有您期望从 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理那里获得的大部分功能：多代理、技能、MCP、持久内存。 区别在于构建理念。

  • 用 Rust 从头开始​​构建。 像 Grep（完全重建和定制）和 git 这样的核心组件嵌入到同一个约 15MB 的二进制文件中，并在运行时在同一个进程中运行，因此没有任何内容被删除，也没有资源泄漏。 大多数类似的项目都在 Node.js 或 CPython 上运行，并且占用的空间要大一个数量级。
  • 内置本地推理：该引擎是 llama.cpp 的固定托管版本，因此本地 GGUF 模型就是 Ante 在没有任何提供程序的情况下运行所需的全部。 要研究此类引擎的工作原理，请参阅我们的玩具版本 nanochat-rs。
  • 没有供应商锁定，甚至我们自己也没有：不需要帐户，可以重复使用您现有的 API 凭据。 antix.antigma.ai 提供选择性加入、完全集成的服务器端体验。
  • 每项主张均得到我们所发布的确切构建的公开、可重复基准的支持：antigma.ai/eval。

除了足迹之外，它还取决于代理架构，最终取决于谁在构建它以及以什么理念构建它。 任何人都可以 fork 一个二进制文件；品味和工程严谨性是无法复制的。 这些差异渗透到产品的每一个细节中。

Why care about runtime optimization like memory and I/O if model inference is usually the biggest bottleneck?

对于一对一代理交互，内存使用和 I/O 等运行时开销通常不如模型推理重要。

但我们的愿景要远大得多：数以百万计的智能体进行大规模的自组织和通信。 到那时，即使很小的低效率也会成倍数百万或数十亿倍，因此运行时优化在经济上变得意义重大。

Can I run Ante completely offline?

是的。 Ante 有一个内置的 llama.cpp 引擎，可以在本地运行 GGUF 模型。 它自动处理引擎安装、模型发现和内存管理。 无需 API 密钥或互联网连接。

Can I use my own custom models or providers?

是的。 创建 ~/.ante/catalog.json 文件以使用自定义端点、API 密钥和配置添加或覆盖提供程序和模型。 任何与 OpenAI 兼容的 API 都可以使用。

What is the ante serve mode for?

服务器模式将 Ante 作为长期守护进程运行，通过结构化 JSONL 协议进行通信。 它非常适合在 Ante 之上构建编辑器插件、Web UI 和自定义集成。
